title: skills(ui): teach resultDialog (incl. table format) and the aggregate bulk handler's BulkActionResult
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4n2wzAmmp4Z6W5jsqtM2qx)_
Fixes #34648
Fixes #34268
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用 AI 写界面动作的人,现在能让 AI 正确写出「执行后弹出一次性结果框(含表格)」和「批量动作逐行报告成败」两种写法;已有应用无感。
- 为什么做:这两项能力平台已经上线,但对外发布的界面技能包里没有教,AI 写不出来或写错。
- 出错会怎样:只是教学文字,写错最多让 AI 给出不准确的建议,撤回本次改动即可恢复。
- 要你做什么:无。界面动作这份教学文件的长度上限按既有裁决「先削重复,余额按实测提高」随实测上调了 378 个计数单位,请在合并审阅时留意这一行。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, two bullets in the "Visibility, Disable & Feedback" list, each written from the merged schema and its reader, not from the card text:

- **`resultDialog`** (beside `preflight`): the dialog replaces the success toast and is refused beside `outcomeMessages`; its keys; the `fields` row; the six formats; `table` with its `columns` (one row per element of the array at `path`, one cell per column, required with `table`, refused beside any other format); the dialog-level default and a cell's format take every format but `table`. It says a `text` or `code-list` cell has no copy control and a `secret` or `qrcode` cell keeps its own, which is what `ActionAnswerTableColumnSchema.format` describes and `ActionResultDialog.tsx` draws. The card's proposed sentence was checked against `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` and kept where it matched.
- **Aggregate bulk handler**: an `execution: 'aggregate'` handler that wrote some rows and refused others catches per row and resolves `{ succeeded: string[], failed: [{ id, message }] }` (`BulkActionResult`) as its whole return value; a throw is one outcome for the selection; ids outside `_selectedIds` are dropped, a duplicate counts once, an id in both lists is failed, a selected id in neither is not confirmed; a value with neither member keeps the whole-selection report and one with either member that does not parse is unreadable. Source: `BulkActionResultSchema` in `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` and `readAggregateResult` in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts`.
- One restatement cut in the same file: the `preflight` bullet no longer spells the `{ path, label?, format? }` row that the `resultDialog` bullet right below it now states (28 bytes).
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `rules/actions.md` row only, 3333 to 3711 with its note (see Token budget).
- `.changeset/34648-skills-result-dialog-bulk-result.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

Net added lines for the whole PR, changeset included: **43** (`git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD`: 45 added, 2 deleted), under the order's 45.

## Evals

Two cases appended to `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`:

- id 22: an api action returning a count and an array of rejected rows. `must_contain`: `resultDialog`, `format: 'table'`, `columns`, `rejected`, `reason`. `must_not_contain`: `columns: ['email'` (column names in place of column objects) and `display: 'table'` (a refused alias).
- id 23: an aggregate script handler whose per-row throw fails the whole run. `must_contain`: `_selectedIds`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `message`, `catch`. `must_not_contain`: `succeeded: ids.length` (a count where a list is required).

Neither refusal list holds a bare identifier a correct answer may mention. The cases were not run against a model in this PR.

## Token budget

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` had zero headroom on main: 13330 bytes, 3333 tokens, ceiling 3333. Raise path: the standing maintainer ruling of 2026-10-27, 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」, ruling record 6513306068 (letter B).

- Paid down first: 28 bytes of restatement in the same file, the `{ path, label?, format? }` row on the `preflight` bullet, which the `resultDialog` bullet right below it now spells.
- Arithmetic: the text adds 1541 bytes, the cut removes 28, so the file is 13330 to 14843 bytes.
- Tokens before 3333, after 3711; ceiling +378, the measured remainder only, pinned at the measurement: `ceil(14843 / 4) == 3711`.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` at head 060842a240: exit 0, "skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md is 3711 tokens (ceiling 3711; headroom 0)".

Two-minute check: open `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, read the `resultDialog` bullet under `preflight` and the last bullet of the same list, and compare with the `.describe` strings of `ActionAnswerTableColumnSchema` and `BulkActionResultSchema`.

Read first, by risk: (1) the `resultDialog` bullet's copy-control sentence; (2) the aggregate bullet's counting rules; (3) the two `must_not_contain` lists.

## Acceptance notes

- Noted, not changed here: the same file's `list_toolbar` row and its Add to Campaign example read the selection as `input.selectedIds`, while `packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts` names `_selectedIds` as the built-in key and calls `selectedIds` its near-miss spelling. Not reproduced at a public door in this PR.
- The evals README's one-line summary of this fixture is left as is.
